name: protect-ci-workflows
description: Stops an agent weakening the checks that review its work. Shell guard refuses writes to .github/workflows/, .github/actions/, .github/dependabot.y*ml (redirect, rm/mv/tee/sed -i, cp into, git checkout/restore, cmdlets); reads and `chock sync` pass. Edit/Write: tool_use gate asks a person before a write to CI, hook or bot config (GitLab, Jenkins, CircleCI, CODEOWNERS, husky, more). Not judged: deletions, empty writes, shell writes to non-GitHub CI paths; plugin installs ship no gate.
